source_policy: Corrected geometry now replaces the canonical building paths. Previous files and temporary prepared outputs archived outside project.
limitations: Known intentionally raised structures must be listed in EXCLUDE_BAG_IDS.
Only flat, supported base patches with clean bottom/wall connections are extended.
Coverage checks compare intersected projected areas; self-intersections and all mesh/terrain defects are not repaired.
Source roof openings/nonmanifold edges can remain. A zero gap count is not simulation-ready certification.
